newsitem.title: USA: Mobil may sell some California assets.
newsitem.headline: Mobil may sell some California assets.

text.p: Mobil Exploration & Producing US Inc said Tuesday it is negotiating the sale of its Platform Holly operation in California with Venoco Inc, an independent oil and gas company that operates 10 fields in the western United States.
Mobil said the Platform Holly produces about 5,000 barrels of oil and 3 million cubic feet (MMcf) of natural gas per day.
It said the negotiations also include the Ellwood Marine Terminal and Ellwood Processing Facility, both in Goleta, California.
A final sale is expected to be completed this summer, Mobil said.
The company said further details of the sale would be disclosed then.
